timecoded_text_to_speech.text: a Hoi Hoi and welcome to the channel. I'm Dr. Samarian, not a real doctor, and today we are
going to see a trailer for the 8K contest entry that I just dropped along with all of my co-authors,
including Harry Blank, Billeth, and Placeholder McDoctoritt. The trailer here has got voice acting
from me and music and video created by Billeth. If you want to see the 8K entry itself,
there will be a link in the description below at the very top.
We don't create a fantasy world to escape reality. We create it to be able to stay.
Linda Berry. Games are the minds way of creating distance between our internal world and the
outside world. Over long enough period of time that is a necessary part of retaining your sanity.
The object of each game is different. A set of rules agreed upon beforehand to enhance the fun,
but the object of this game will be to pocket the 8 ball.
